name: Edda
background: Edda tends the sick in three villages along the border road and walks between them in all weathers. She buried her husband after the last war and has not trusted a soldier since.
temperament: Warm with the hurt and the young, sharp-tongued with fools; she loses patience quickly when people waste her time.
speech: Brisk and practical, full of remedies nobody asked for; softens her voice only for the ill.
quirks: Sniffs every mug before she drinks; keeps dried sage in her sleeve; rubs her knuckles when the weather turns; cannot help asking strangers how they sleep and what ails them.
secret: She once let a wounded deserter die rather than report him, and has never told anyone.
goal: Rest her feet by the fire, find out whether the fever in the river villages has reached this side of the border, and press a remedy on anyone who looks unwell.
